title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models
authors: J. Wei, X. Wang, D. Schuurmans, et al. (9 authors)
before: Models answered arithmetic and logic questions in one step and got them wrong.
problem: Hard problems need intermediate work, but nothing in the prompt asked for it.
breakthrough: Put worked examples showing the reasoning steps in the prompt, and the model reasons step by step too.
why: It showed reasoning was latent and could be elicited, which is the seed of the entire test-time compute era.
next: Zero-shot CoT, self-consistency, tree of thoughts, and eventually RL-trained reasoning in o1 and R1.
inherits: Thinking before answering, now trained in rather than prompted for.
